title: WoT Blitz Memory Offset Table
description: Discovered memory offsets for reading replay state from the game process.

executableSha256.description: SHA-256 of wotblitz.exe, for exact binary matching.

discoveredAtUtc.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when offsets were last updated.

replayTime.description: Base-relative offset for replay timeline (double, seconds). 0 = unknown.

playerHP.description: Base-relative offset for player HP (int32). 0 = unknown.

playerPositionX.description: Base-relative offset for player position X (float, world units). 0 = unknown.

playerPositionY.description: Base-relative offset for player position Y / height (float). 0 = unknown.

playerPositionZ.description: Base-relative offset for player position Z (float, world units). 0 = unknown.

playerYaw.description: Base-relative offset for player yaw (float, radians). 0 = unknown.

cameraPitch.description: Base-relative offset for camera pitch (float, radians). 0 = unknown.

aliveTankCount.description: Base-relative offset for alive tank count (int32). 0 = unknown.

confidence.description: How confident we are in these offsets.

notes.description: Free-form notes about discovery process, quirks, or caveats.
